notes.title: New stage and improved color scheme for color blindness.
notes.content: [p][b]What’s new in this version:[/b][/p][list][*][p]A new stage for the extra mode, inspired by cinema;[/p][/*][*][p]Improved color-blind mode with better contrast and new sprites with icons to help identify turns and tiles;[/p][/*][*][p]Minor fixes to the explosion and shock flash sprites;[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to the bot's code;[/p][/*][/list][p][b]What’s next:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Implementation of a P2P system to play with Steam friends;[/p][/*][*][p]New story mode with progressive challenges (currently in testing);[/p][/*][*][p]New chain reaction mode;[/p][/*][*][p]More victory quotes in all 6 available languages;[/p][/*][/list]
